articles.article_text: After reporting a blowout quarter, Nvidia Corporation stock is popping higher toward its all-time highs in the after-hours session - reversing this week's pre-ER losses. Powered by insatiable demand for its AI GPU chips, Nvidia's Data Center business quintupled y/y to $18.4B! Further, management issued strong guidance for Q1 FY2025. During Q4, Nvidia's non-GAAP gross margin expanded by 200 bps, and its quarterly free cash flow jumped to $11.2B in Q4 2023. While Nvidia's business is going from strength to strength in the era of AI, the stock has experienced a vertical move-up in recent weeks. With Nvidia Corporation shares sitting at $721 in after-hours, is it a buy, sell, or hold? Read on to find out! Looking for a helping hand in the market?
